# Sway keyboard reference

`Mod` is Super.

## Launcher

| Shortcut        | Action                                   |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Mod + T         | Run `ghostty`                            |
| Mod + D         | Run `noctalia msg panel-toggle launcher` |
| Mod + Space     | Run `vicinae open`                       |
| Mod + S         | Run `noctalia msg screenshot-region`     |
| Super + Alt + L | Run `noctalia msg session lock`          |

## Media keys

| Shortcut              | Action                               |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| XF86AudioRaiseVolume  | Run `noctalia msg volume-up 5`       |
| XF86AudioLowerVolume  | Run `noctalia msg volume-down 5`     |
| XF86AudioMute         | Run `noctalia msg volume-mute`       |
| XF86AudioMicMute      | Run `noctalia msg mic-mute`          |
| XF86AudioPlay         | Run `noctalia msg media toggle`      |
| XF86AudioStop         | Run `noctalia msg media stop`        |
| XF86AudioPrev         | Run `noctalia msg media previous`    |
| XF86AudioNext         | Run `noctalia msg media next`        |
| XF86MonBrightnessUp   | Run `noctalia msg brightness-up 5`   |
| XF86MonBrightnessDown | Run `noctalia msg brightness-down 5` |

## Window focus

| Shortcut    | Action                                  |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------- |
| Mod + O     | Run `noctalia msg window-switcher open` |
| Mod + Q     | Close window                            |
| Mod + Left  | Focus left                              |
| Mod + Down  | Focus down                              |
| Mod + Up    | Focus up                                |
| Mod + Right | Focus right                             |
| Mod + H     | Focus left                              |
| Mod + J     | Focus down                              |
| Mod + K     | Focus up                                |
| Mod + L     | Focus right                             |

## Window movement

| Shortcut           | Action     |
| ------------------ | ---------- |
| Mod + Ctrl + Left  | Move left  |
| Mod + Ctrl + Down  | Move down  |
| Mod + Ctrl + Up    | Move up    |
| Mod + Ctrl + Right | Move right |
| Mod + Ctrl + H     | Move left  |
| Mod + Ctrl + J     | Move down  |
| Mod + Ctrl + K     | Move up    |
| Mod + Ctrl + L     | Move right |

## Output focus

| Shortcut            | Action             |
| ------------------- | ------------------ |
| Mod + Shift + Left  | Focus output left  |
| Mod + Shift + Down  | Focus output down  |
| Mod + Shift + Up    | Focus output up    |
| Mod + Shift + Right | Focus output right |
| Mod + Shift + H     | Focus output left  |
| Mod + Shift + J     | Focus output down  |
| Mod + Shift + K     | Focus output up    |
| Mod + Shift + L     | Focus output right |

## Move a container to another output

| Shortcut                   | Action                         |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Mod + Shift + Ctrl + Left  | Move container to output left  |
| Mod + Shift + Ctrl + Down  | Move container to output down  |
| Mod + Shift + Ctrl + Up    | Move container to output up    |
| Mod + Shift + Ctrl + Right | Move container to output right |
| Mod + Shift + Ctrl + H     | Move container to output left  |
| Mod + Shift + Ctrl + J     | Move container to output down  |
| Mod + Shift + Ctrl + K     | Move container to output up    |
| Mod + Shift + Ctrl + L     | Move container to output right |

## Workspace focus

| Shortcut        | Action                   |
| --------------- | ------------------------ |
| Mod + Page_Down | Focus workspace next     |
| Mod + Page_Up   | Focus workspace previous |
| Mod + U         | Focus workspace next     |
| Mod + I         | Focus workspace previous |

## Move a container to another workspace

| Shortcut               | Action                               |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Mod + Ctrl + Page_Down | Move container to workspace next     |
| Mod + Ctrl + Page_Up   | Move container to workspace previous |
| Mod + Ctrl + U         | Move container to workspace next     |
| Mod + Ctrl + I         | Move container to workspace previous |

## Workspaces by index

| Shortcut       | Action                        |
| -------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Mod + 1        | Focus workspace 1             |
| Mod + 2        | Focus workspace 2             |
| Mod + 3        | Focus workspace 3             |
| Mod + 4        | Focus workspace 4             |
| Mod + 5        | Focus workspace 5             |
| Mod + 6        | Focus workspace 6             |
| Mod + 7        | Focus workspace 7             |
| Mod + 8        | Focus workspace 8             |
| Mod + 9        | Focus workspace 9             |
| Mod + Ctrl + 1 | Move container to workspace 1 |
| Mod + Ctrl + 2 | Move container to workspace 2 |
| Mod + Ctrl + 3 | Move container to workspace 3 |
| Mod + Ctrl + 4 | Move container to workspace 4 |
| Mod + Ctrl + 5 | Move container to workspace 5 |
| Mod + Ctrl + 6 | Move container to workspace 6 |
| Mod + Ctrl + 7 | Move container to workspace 7 |
| Mod + Ctrl + 8 | Move container to workspace 8 |
| Mod + Ctrl + 9 | Move container to workspace 9 |

## Wheel navigation

| Shortcut                        | Action                               |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Mod + Wheel Up                  | Focus workspace previous             |
| Mod + Wheel Down                | Focus workspace next                 |
| Mod + Ctrl + Wheel Up           | Move container to workspace previous |
| Mod + Ctrl + Wheel Down         | Move container to workspace next     |
| Mod + Shift + Wheel Up          | Focus left                           |
| Mod + Shift + Wheel Down        | Focus right                          |
| Mod + Ctrl + Shift + Wheel Up   | Move left                            |
| Mod + Ctrl + Shift + Wheel Down | Move right                           |

## Sizing

| Shortcut               | Action               |
| ---------------------- | -------------------- |
| Mod + R                | Set width to 50%     |
| Mod + Shift + R        | Set width to 33%     |
| Mod + Ctrl + Shift + R | Set height to 50%    |
| Mod + Ctrl + R         | Set height to 100%   |
| Mod + F                | Toggle fullscreen    |
| Mod + Shift + F        | Toggle fullscreen    |
| Mod + Minus            | Shrink width by 10%  |
| Mod + Equal            | Grow width by 10%    |
| Mod + Shift + Minus    | Shrink height by 10% |
| Mod + Shift + Equal    | Grow height by 10%   |

## Floating and tabbed layouts

| Shortcut        | Action                                   |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Mod + V         | Toggle floating                          |
| Mod + Shift + V | Switch focus between floating and tiling |
| Mod + W         | Cycle the container layout               |

## Screenshots

| Shortcut     | Action                                   |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------- |
| Print        | Run `noctalia msg screenshot-region`     |
| Ctrl + Print | Run `noctalia msg screenshot-fullscreen` |

## Session

| Shortcut            | Action                            |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| Mod + Escape        | Toggle keyboard shortcuts inhibit |
| Mod + Shift + E     | Exit Sway                         |
| Ctrl + Alt + Delete | Exit Sway                         |
